tier_compliance.reason: “Each cell represents one possible offspring combination” connects the visible cells to possible offspring genotypes without deciding the probability.

visual_grounding.reason: “Four possible outcomes” and “each cell” refer to the four visible Ee cells in this Punnett square.

scientific_correctness.reason: The EE and ee parents have different eye colors, and each cell represents a possible offspring allele combination.

steers_toward_wrong_answer.reason: Interpreting the cells as possible offspring combinations is consistent with calculating the probability of red eyes.

answer_disclosure.reason: The hint does not identify the offspring eye color, count red-eyed outcomes, or favor any option.

actionability.reason: “Each cell represents one possible offspring combination” gives a clear focus, but the student must determine how to use the cells to calculate the probability.
